parameters.name: datasetCode
parameters.description: Eurostat dataflow/dataset code returned by catalogue and verified against SDMX metadata.

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Optional repeated short geographic codes returned by the selected dataset's SDMX metadata (for example SE). Pass codes only, never URLs or labels.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Optional repeated time-period codes returned by the selected dataset's SDMX metadata (for example 2020). Pass codes only, never labels or URLs.
